moderation.pageSubtitle: Archive, restore or delete anything people publish
moderation.hint: Archive, restore or delete any listing, offer, event, news item, post, comment or review

actions.archiveHint: Hide it from the website. You can restore it later.
actions.restoreHint: Show it on the website again.
actions.deleteHint: Remove it and its related data for good.

archive.title: Archive this content?
archive.body: It will disappear from the website, search, the home page and feeds. Nothing is deleted, and you can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore this content?
restore.body: It will be visible on the website again, following the usual publishing rules.

delete.title: Delete permanently?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. The item is removed from the database together with its related data (such as comments, reviews, offers and saves). Its images are deleted when nothing else uses them.
delete.tick: I understand that this cannot be undone.

moderation.reasonHint: Only admins see this. It is kept in the audit log.

done.archive: Archived. It is no longer on the website.
